get.description: Return the current status of an async log export job.

post.description: Authenticate user credentials and return JWT tokens.
Revoke the refresh token and clear user session.
Generate a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Create a user account and its default-project atomically, then return JWT access and refresh tokens.
Send with X-API-Key or a Bearer token. A project API key supplies project_id automatically and is restricted to that project.
Run a grouped/time-bucketed aggregation over logs.
Start an asynchronous log export job; returns the export job ID.
Search logs in a project visible to the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieve a log from an accessible project. Supply project_id for shared projects.
Return owned and shared projects, including the caller’s persisted project role.

post.description: Create a new project within the authenticated tenant.

put.description: Update fields on an existing project.

delete.summary: Remove or leave a project team
